description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ahri''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 40% '''bonus''' movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjures three flames which orbit her clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Ahri gains  40% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjures three flames which orbit her clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds.

description2.raw: After 0.25 seconds of the cast, each flame targets a [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemy based on priority, or after 0.4 seconds, simply targets the closest visible enemy in range. Each flame deals magic damage, with subsequent flames against a target dealing 40% damage.
description2.text: After 0.25 seconds of the cast, each flame targets a visible enemy based on priority, or after 0.4 seconds, simply targets the closest visible enemy in range. Each flame deals magic damage, with subsequent flames against a target dealing 40% damage.

description3.raw: Flames prioritize enemy champions hit by ''[[File:Ahri Charm.png|20xpx|border|link=Ahri#Charm|An icon for Ahri's ability Charm]] [[Ahri#Charm|Charm]]'', then enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]], then minions that would die to ''Fox-Fire's'' damage, and then the target of '''Ahri's''' last basic attack within 3 seconds.
description3.text: Flames prioritize enemy champions hit by Charm, then enemy champions, then minions that would die to Fox-Fire's damage, and then the target of Ahri's last basic attack within 3 seconds.

description4.raw: ''Fox-Fire's'' damage is doubled against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 20% '''maximum''' health.
description4.text: Fox-Fire's damage is doubled against minions below  20% maximum health.

notes.raw:
* Each missile of ''Fox-Fire'' has its own shorter non-priority range.
* Any unused ''Fox-Fires'' will fizzle upon death.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
